test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
A # B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A & B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A % B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A * B means ‘A is the son of B’

If P @ M % H # A @ G & B, then how is B related to P?
solution:

P @ M % H # A @ G & B → P is daughter of M, M is wife of H, H is brother of A, A is daughter of G, G is husband of B.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

Clearly, B is paternal grandmother, i.e., father's mother of P.

Hence, ‘**Father’s mother**’ is the correct answer.
